findings.fix: Write `let := P.indexNeg; simp_rw [← RootPairing.indexNeg_neg]; exact Set.ncard_image_of_injective _ neg_injective`, or factor `Function.Involutive (fun i ↦ P.reflectionPerm i i)` out as a named lemma and use `.injective` here and at line 281.
findings.issue: The inline injectivity proof of `fun i ↦ P.reflectionPerm i i` re-derives `neg_injective` for the `InvolutiveNeg ι` supplied by `P.indexNeg`, and duplicates the `hinv` involutivity proof already present at lines 281-283 of this file.

summary: The generic count is genuinely new (Mathlib has no `posRoots` API and TauCeti had no positive-root count), but two of the new proofs re-derive located lemmas: Mathlib's `Set.ncard_add_ncard_compl` and `neg_injective`, the latter also already proved inline in the same file.
